<title>ae683f770</title>
  <style>
    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    body {
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e1e2f, #2a2a45);
    }
    svg {
      width: min(400px, 80vw);
      height: min(400px, 80vw);
      filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4));
    }
    circle {
      fill: url(#circleGradient);
      transition: transform 0.2s ease;
      transform-origin: center;
    }
    circle:hover {
      transform: scale(1.03);
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <svg id="ae683f770" viewBox="0 0 400 400">
    <defs>
      <radialGradient id="circleGradient" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="75%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8ab4ff"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3b5bdb"/>
      </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    <circle cx="200" cy="196" r="196"/>
  </svg>
</body>
</html>
